parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 9.665 m – 47.738 m
Recommendation: Target the high-resistivity sandy layer between approximately 9.7 m and 47.7 m depth for screen placement, as this zone shows strong resistivity contrast (4591.4 ohm-m) indicative of a productive aquifer; confirm lithology during drilling since the underlying layer (5101.5 ohm-m) may represent a continuation of the same water-bearing formation or competent basement.
